scope: Content-schema contribution to the single generic Code Synopsis Form owner. Do not create a second role-qualified Declaration. Code references, identity, lifecycle, consumers, and actual implementation remain separately owned.

merge_target.owner: single generic Form Declaration for Code Synopsis
merge_target.instruction: Merge this content rule into the single generic Code Synopsis Form owner; do not create a second declaration.
merge_target.role_constraint: The one generic Form owner constrains bound Code Synopsis instances to Role Implementation; do not create a separate role-qualified Form Declaration.

content_contract.summary: The existing mandatory Summary is sufficient; do not add a redundant Content text-leaf cardinality rule.
content_contract.body: Require the existing empty Claim container with one or two existing children, Formal Claim and/or Prose Claim. Each child is optional individually and holds Markdown; Formal Claim uses the existing CFEL fence contract. This lets an author state actual facts formally, add prose explanation, or do both. The Role supplies actual-state meaning, so the use of Formal Claim does not make the content normative.
content_contract.reuse: R2498 supplies generic Markdown Content; R2499 already requires Summary; R2500 defines the empty Claim container and one-or-two child shape; R2721/R2722 define existing Formal/Prose Claim contracts. The single generic Code Synopsis Form owner reuses these properties and binds the Form to Role Implementation.
boundaries: Partial descriptions and absence of a specification are allowed.
Rationale is optional; distinguish observed facts from inferences and identify evidence when available.
A specification difference is neutral unless assessed as needing resolution.
M307 has no Implementation CCE profile; none is borrowed or introduced.
No code-location schema is included in this lane.
content_contract.current_scope_note: R2500/R2721/R2722 describe ordinary RMED Claim use. The single Form owner explicitly applies the existing child shape to Code Synopsis; Role Implementation makes its statements descriptive of actual state rather than normative intent.

authoring_method: No additional Method proposed. The Form contract states the content meaning and boundaries directly; details on code references and lifecycle belong to their separate contracts.

source_pins.summary: Derive Implementation and use its actual state as source

proposal_removed: The prior role-qualified standalone declaration was withdrawn; the root Form owner will carry the Implementation role constraint.
